programs.title: Space Greed S1 - "Arming Space Force"
programs.desc: In this episode, we explore all the ways in which wars in space might be fought and who stands to make a pretty penny developing space-age weaponry.

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Mars vs. the Moon"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli investigates this dilemma which will determine our space-faring future.

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Landing on Mars"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at the varied and ingenious methods used to land spacecraft on the red planet, starting with Pathfinder in 1997.

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "A Year of Space Odyssey"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli explores the amazing journeys of spacecraft that gathered spectacular images of Mercury, Jupiter and Mars.

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Surviving in Deep Space"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at how surviving in deep space can become a reality.

programs.title: The New Frontier S3 - "Living in Space"
programs.desc: How do astronauts cope with living in space? The unique environment, the lack of taste in their food and the smell of canned air all contribute to the stresses of living and working in space.
